decisions.selectedMeaning: Define a product-level readback observation only: identify the exact owner, authoritative effect source, evidence reference, and permitted finality states; missing evidence yields UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE and never authorizes replay.
mandatoryConditions: Define authoritative effect-observation input as exact owner-controlled effect source reference, effect identity, observed version/revision, typed evidence ref, observation time and finality value.

Separate reconnect-session state from product-effect state. Missing/unavailable/unverified owner binding or evidence returns UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE; never infer safe resume, scene ownership, completed effects or permission to replay.
Required genuine owner endpoint binding remains an explicit execution prerequisite; this source direction supplies no endpoint or runtime grant.

decisions.selectedMeaning: Define user-facing custom voice tuning as a separate product intent with source version, rights/purpose, requested tuning dimensions, output/version semantics, retention, and authorized actor.
mandatoryConditions: Define separately selectable authorized custom-voice tuning intent with immutable source voice/version, requested versioned tuning-profile/dimensions, permitted purpose, rights/consent ref, authorized actor, retention/deletion policy ref, and candidate output/version lineage.
Tuning must not silently enroll, train, adapt or replace a canonical model. Any training/adaptation or activation is a separate explicit governed operation.
Unsupported tuning profiles/dimensions, missing rights/purpose/retention authority or revoked consent reject; unknown outcome remains unknown and requires reconciliation.

decisions.selectedMeaning: Define a source-free synthetic voice persona feature with explicit non-identity claims, identity policy, rights boundary, selection inputs, output, and prohibited impersonation cases.
mandatoryConditions: Define a source-free synthetic voice-persona design intent distinct from authorized cloning. Inputs include non-identity design attributes, admitted voice-design profile, tenant/actor and applicable rights/identity policy refs.
Output is a clearly synthetic local voice-persona candidate/version with design provenance; no assertion that it represents or is endorsed by a real person.
A request to imitate, misrepresent or enroll an identifiable person requires separately genuine identity/rights/consent authority and is unavailable under this source-free branch.

decisions.selectedMeaning: Define enrollment only with exact subject/avatar identity, consent/rights scope, enrollment purpose, authorized decision authority, revocation and lifecycle semantics.
mandatoryConditions: Define avatar/persona enrollment as its own governed operation with exact subject identity ref, avatar/persona/version, purpose, consent/rights scope and version, actual authorized decision source, revocation/deletion/lifecycle contract and auditable outcome ref.

Resolving a consent reference is not enrollment. Missing, expired, revoked or mismatched scope rejects; unavailable actual authority or ambiguous external effect remains UNKNOWN and cannot be replayed automatically.
No actual identity verification, consent, likeness right, credential, enrollment state or specialist approval is supplied by this direction.

decisions.selectedMeaning: Define a compatibility observation against one explicitly named profile/target and disclose supported, unsupported, and unknown dimensions; make no standards-conformance claim.
mandatoryConditions: Define exact profile/target compatibility observation with versioned requested and effective profile, declared applicability dimensions, supported/unsupported/unknown results and current evidence provenance.

Retain standards-conformance as a separate required branch when requested by the original criterion: real standard/version, authorized conformance decision source, test method/target and authentic evidence are mandatory, and missing inputs yield UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE.
A compatibility result alone never satisfies certification or standards-conformance acceptance.

decisions.selectedMeaning: Define only a product readiness observation from explicitly declared legal and hardware criteria and current evidence; unknown criteria/evidence must remain UNKNOWN and never become legal clearance.
mandatoryConditions: Define product readiness observation with separately typed technical/hardware and legal/rights criterion results, exact requested target/profile/hardware, criterion owner/source and current evidence refs.

Actual legal clearance requires genuine authorized legal decision evidence; unknown legal criteria/evidence stays UNKNOWN and prevents a clearance claim. A technical observation cannot substitute for legal approval.
Hardware capability/admission evidence and legal decision evidence remain distinct. No professional judgment, equipment qualification, deployment or release approval is issued by this direction.
This is a new delegated product-source choice, not a claim that existing code or standards already specify these numbers.
Preserve immutable source artifact/version and declared color/profile basis; output is a local adjusted candidate with requested/effective parameter provenance.

Unsupported profile/space or factor, non-finite/wrong-precision input and missing source version reject without silent clamp/substitution. Neutral value preserves saturation intent; actual algorithm/colorimetric and fidelity contracts are authored at their owning PDP phases.
Do not claim implementation, gamut/fidelity/quality qualification or canonical project commit. Add exact boundary/default/neutral/negative source acceptance cases.
